from datetime import datetime
now = datetime.now()
print('now', now.isoformat())
# compute non-expired cards
cards_status=[]
for c in payment_cards:
    ey=int(c.get('expiry_year'))
    em=int(float(c.get('expiry_month')))
    # Assume expiry_year/month are actual calendar values
    # Check if last day of expiry month is before now
    import calendar
    last_day = calendar.monthrange(ey, em)[1]
    exp_dt = datetime(ey, em, last_day, 23, 59, 59)
    expired = exp_dt < now
    cards_status.append({
        'payment_card_id': c['payment_card_id'],
        'card_name': c.get('card_name'),
        'expiry_year': ey,
        'expiry_month': em,
        'expired': expired
    })
print(cards_status)
non_expired=[c for c in payment_cards if not (datetime(int(c.get('expiry_year')), int(float(c.get('expiry_month'))), 28) < now)]
